summary: Kelso Technologies Inc. filed Form 6-K furnishing materials for its 2026 Annual General Meeting, including notice of meeting, information circular, proxy, notice of availability, and NI card. The meeting is scheduled for June 4, 2026, to receive audited financial statements, appoint CBIZ CPAs P.C. as auditor, and elect five directors. This is a routine shareholder meeting filing with no special situation event such as M&A, restructuring, or activist campaign. No deal terms are present.
